messages:
Sam (Design): sharing a quick Figma clip of the compact channel selector — thinking about collapse behavior when users have 5+ channels. https://figma.com/some-proto (cc @Maya PM)
Maya PM: looking now. main question: when collapsed, do we still show the active channel badge? or switch to a count chip?
Sam (Design): current proposal: show a single pill with channel icon + "3 channels". expand on click. but worried about discoverability for on-call flow.
Devon Eng: implementation note — collapsing into a single chip is cheap, but keyboard reachability is trickier. we need an accessible focus target for each underlying channel (tab should cycle into an expander then arrow keys).
Lenora A11y: recommend: expander is a composite widget with role=menubutton, aria-expanded, and an associated aria-controls for the list. ensure arrow keys move focus within list. contrast: the chip text is 3.6:1 on current bg, needs 4.5:1 for normal text.
Sam (Design): thanks — good catch on contrast. I tried darker chip bg, looks heavy. open to changing copy too ("3 channels" vs "3 notifs").
Toni Product: copy point — users think in terms of destinations not "channels". can we use "3 destinations"? also for snooze vs suppression: PM doc uses "snooze" for temporary, "suppress" for policy-level. Sam, can we show that mapping in the UI?
Sam (Design): yes. draft copy below: "Snooze notifications for 1 hour — temporarily stop alerts from these destinations." and for suppression: "Suppress by schedule — silence matched alerts for the selected window." thoughts?
Lenora A11y: prefer verbs at start for buttons (e.g., "Snooze for 1h") and keep descriptive helper text below. also add aria-live region when a suppression is applied so screen readers announce it.
Devon Eng: re: aria-live — we can fire a polite message like: "Suppression applied: alerts will be silenced until 3:15pm". easy to hook into backend response.
Alex Eng: telemetry: track expand/collapse, how often people open full list after collapse, and which copy variant they click (Snooze vs Suppress). we can A/B test copy.
Maya PM: agree on A/B test. also need a preview panel that shows which rules will match when you toggle suppression. current mock shows "Preview matches (3)", but users wanted inline examples. can we show sample alerts?
Sam (Design): adding inline examples — truncated alert rows with matched fields. concern: performance if preview triggers backend eval. suggest we cache last eval for the route and show cached preview with a "refresh" action.
Devon Eng: caching is ok. we'll run preview on demand. also need to debounce inputs (50–200ms) so we don't spam evals.
Lenora A11y: keyboard + screen reader note for preview: the panel should have focus trap only while open and a clear "Close preview" button. announce number of matches on open via aria-live.
Sam (Design): copy tweak: change "Close preview" to "Back to editor"? Toni?
Toni Product: "Back to editor" reads like navigation. prefer "Close preview" or "Done". keep short.
Sam (Design): ok will use "Close preview". one more microcopy Q: for the small badge that indicates channel priority, label should be "P0/P1" or full words "High/Medium"?
Alex Eng: telemetry-wise shorter codes are fine, but accessibility: screen readers should expose full text via aria-label (e.g., aria-label="Priority: High").
Lenora A11y: +1 — visible shorthand, full accessible label. color alone cannot be sole indicator. add icon or text fallback at small sizes.
Devon Eng: small CSS nit: badges at 12px can clip on Windows rendering. use 13px or ensure line-height >= 16px.
Sam (Design): noted. I'll update Figma with 13px and new contrast. uploading new frame now.
notif-bot: Preview eval finished — 4 matches (cached). link: https://internal/runs/preview/12345 :eyes:
Maya PM: perfect. I'll add a short doc for the A/B test and rollout plan. Sam, can you attach final copy and annotate Figma with aria props?
Sam (Design): will do — aim to push updated frames + copy by EOD. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Alex Eng: once Sam pushes, I'll land accessible attributes and the telemetry hooks in the feature branch.
Devon Eng: I'll wire keyboard interactions and focus management. planning a quick pairing session if needed.
Lenora A11y: happy to review the branch for screen-reader behavior. schedule me for final sign-off.
Toni Product: great ship plan. let's keep the default collapsed state for teams with >3 channels and test retention metrics.
Sam (Design): noted — default collapsed for >3, manual expand persists per user. consensus?
Maya PM: consensus. moving to RFC stage.
Sam (Design): thanks all — closing thread after I upload updates.
